mind_map.root_topic: Chapter 10: The Other Side of Zero

sub_branches.concept_or_rule: Directed Quantities & Number Line Extension Below 0
step_by_step_procedure: Extend whole numbers below zero to represent opposite directed quantities.
Positive integers (+1, +2, +3...) lie right of 0.
Negative integers (-1, -2, -3...) lie left of 0.
Zero (0) is neutral (neither positive nor negative).
sub_branches.example_problem: Compare -10 and -3: -10 lies further left on number line => -10 < -3.

step_by_step_procedure: Building Lift: Upper floors (+1, +2...), Ground floor (0), Basement levels (-1, -2...).
Temperature: Above freezing (+°C), Freezing point (0°C), Below freezing (-°C).
Finance: Income/Deposit (+), Balance (0), Debt/Withdrawal (-).
sub_branches.example_problem: Lift at floor +12 moves down 15 floors: +12 - 15 = -3 (Basement level 3).

step_by_step_procedure: The additive inverse of an integer a is -a.
Adding a number and its additive inverse yields zero.
Adding a positive integer -> Move RIGHT on number line.
Adding a negative integer -> Move LEFT on number line.
Subtracting a positive integer -> Move LEFT on number line.
Subtracting a negative integer -> Move RIGHT on number line.
formulas_and_identities: a + (+b) = Right b; a + (-b) = Left b; a - (-b) = Right b
sub_branches.example_problem: Evaluate 2 + (-5): Start at 2, move 5 units left => Reaches -3.

step_by_step_procedure: Represent positive numbers with green (+1) tokens and negative numbers with red (-1) tokens.
Pair one green and one red token to form zero-pairs (+1 + -1 = 0) and cancel out.
Count remaining uncancelled tokens for net result.
sub_branches.example_problem: Evaluate -8 + 13: 8 red tokens cancel with 8 green tokens; 5 green tokens remain => +5.

sub_branches.concept_or_rule: Algebraic Rule for Subtracting Negative Integers
step_by_step_procedure: Subtracting a negative integer is equivalent to adding its positive opposite.
Change double negative '- (-b)' to '+ b'.

branches.theme: 10.4 Brahmagupta's Laws of Zero & Integer Arithmetic

step_by_step_procedure: Brahmagupta (628 CE, Brahmasphutasiddhanta) defined formal laws for zero and negative numbers.
Law 1: A - A = 0.
Law 2: A - 0 = A.
Law 3: 0 - A = -A.

sub_branches.concept_or_rule: Multi-step Integer Expressions & Real-World Word Problems
step_by_step_procedure: Set up mathematical expression with correct signs for gains (+), drops (-), deposits (+), and withdrawals (-).
Evaluate systematically from left to right using operational rules.
formulas_and_identities: Net Position = Initial + Sum of Changes
sub_branches.example_problem: Submarine at -250 m dives 120 m deeper (-120 m) then ascends 180 m (+180 m): -250 - 120 + 180 = -190 m (190 m below sea level).
